'''Lantikus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he asked an Imperial to send out a false all-clear signal to lure out a Republic battalion in hiding.<ref name="TOR" />
